Hi Samir / Olivia —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery:

- Estimated first-year contract: ~$72k (annualized) for the Dedicated capacity + support bundle.
- Procurement constraints you mentioned: AP requires a vendor onboarding packet (vendor form + W-9), and POs are preferred for commitments; credit card payment is typically limited to ad-hoc purchases.
- You indicated the team may prefer Net30 payment terms if we do a direct PO.

Next steps I propose:
1) I attached a pricing proposal and a short SOW stub for your procurement team to review.
2) If you can, please share the procurement contact (name + email) and any vendor form template — we can pre-populate and send back.
3) We can take two commercial paths: a) direct contract + PO (preferred for enterprise needs) or b) marketplace purchase (AWS Marketplace) which can be faster but has different billing cadence and marketplace fees.

Please let me know which route procurement prefers and the right person to receive the vendor packet. Once we have the vendor form and W-9, we can queue the PO-ready invoice and targeted start dates.

I’m cc’ing Lauren (billing/onboarding) and Aditya (legal/ops) to help with paperwork and timing.

Thanks,

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifications from our side:

- AP policy: we require POs for subscriptions/commitments over $10k/year. Purchases under $5k can be processed on card but are normally one-off.
- Vendor onboarding: procurement will need the vendor form, W-9, and proof of insurance (general liability).
- Payment terms: Net30 is acceptable for direct PO agreements.
- Marketplace: we are open to AWS Marketplace for initial pilots, but procurement needs a formal quote and there are typically additional marketplace fees and billing considerations.

Procurement contact: procurement@finopsco.com (I’ll loop them in once you send the vendor packet).

Please send the finalized proposal + SOW to procurement@finopsco.com and cc billing@finopsco.com.

Samir Shah

Hi Samir / Procurement team —

Attaching your vendor form filled with our basic company details; please let me know if you need any additional fields completed.

To summarize options again so procurement can decide:

Option A — Direct contract + PO (recommended for predictable pricing and enterprise SLA):
- We will execute a short Master Services Agreement + SOW.
- Invoice issued on receipt of PO, Net30 terms.
- No marketplace fees; full contract flexibility.

Option B — AWS Marketplace purchase (quicker procurement turn):
- Subscription purchased via marketplace; billed monthly to card or consolidated invoice through AWS.
- Faster to start but subject to marketplace fees and less flexible contract terms.

If procurement confirms Option A, we’ll send the W-9 and formal quote and work with Lauren on invoicing details. If they prefer the marketplace route, we’ll generate a marketplace quote and share next steps.

Next ask: can procurement confirm the approver who will sign the PO and an expected PO lead time?

Thanks — I’ll stand by to provide anything needed to expedite.

Best,
Marissa
